description:
Permanently delete a flow (DELETE .../flows/{flow}) [DISABLED: set ENABLE_WRITE_OPS=true].
Parameters: flow (required); confirm (must be true — guard against accidents); environment (optional). This cannot be undone.
Uses Microsoft's unofficial api.flow.microsoft.com endpoint, which Microsoft labels unsupported; behavior may change.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually delete.

environment.description: Environment id (from list_environments). Omit to use the user's default environment.

name: delete_flow
